meaning_zh: adj.现代的,近代的,现代化的,新潮的
example_en: The computer had made a great impact on modern life.
example_zh: 计算机对现代生活产生了巨大的影响.

example_en: Mum has just won a microwave cooker.
example_zh: 妈妈刚刚赢得一台微波炉.

example_en: Full name Lee ge grasping mutton, are Qinshui snacks in a wonderful work.
example_zh: 羊肉李圪抓, 是沁水风味小吃中的一朵奇葩.

example_en: Why are you doing that? Sally asked. " To make myself beautiful, " the lady answered.
example_zh: “你为什么干这个 呀 ?”莎利问道. “ 把自己打扮得美丽呀, ” 那妇人回答道.

example_en: The man next to me speaks English.
example_zh: 坐我旁边的那个人讲英语。

meaning_zh: v.点头,点头示意,打盹,顶球
example_en: The lullaby had the baby into the Land of Nod in half an hour.
example_zh: 催眠曲一下子就把小孩子送入了梦乡.

example_en: The various elements of the novel fail to cohere.
example_zh: 这部小说的各部分之间缺乏连贯性。

example_en: Troops were sent to the islands to restore order last November.
example_zh: 去年11月，军队被派往这些岛屿以恢复秩序。

example_en: By October 1990, when arrested, he was hopelessly in debt.
example_zh: 到1990年10月被捕时，他已经负债累累。

example_en: In the light of his remarks, we rejected her offer.
example_zh: 鉴于他的评语, 我们拒绝了她的提议.

meaning_zh: n.军官，警官,高级职员,公务员,船长
example_en: He pulled out the pistol and aimed at the enemy officer.
example_zh: 他拔出手枪,瞄准敌军官.

meaning_zh: pron.“myself”的复数,我们自己,（把）我们自己
example_en: We walked home by ourselves.
example_zh: 我们独自走回家.

example_en: We often read in novels how a seemingly respectable person or family has some terrible secret which has been concealed from strangers for years.
example_zh: 表面上道貌岸然的人或有声望的家庭,却有着骇人听闻,多年不让人知道的秘密,这样的事情我们经常在小说里读到.

meaning_zh: n.电话,听筒,（发声或使用声音的）工具,说某种语言的
example_en: Using a false accent over the phone is a sign of inferiority.
example_zh: 打电话时故意作出某种口音是自卑的表现.

example_en: They are picking up trash.
example_zh: 他们在捡垃圾。

meaning_zh: n.馅饼，派,爱说话的人,[动]喜鹊,<美俚>容易得到的称心东西，容易的工作
example_en: For me, baseball is as American as apple pie.
example_zh: 对我来说, 棒球同苹果馅饼一样是地道的美国玩意儿.

example_en: It's a pity the room has no north window and you don't get a draught.
example_zh: 可惜这房间没北窗,没有过堂风.

example_en: There are plenty of distractions here.
example_zh: 这里有许多娱乐活动.

meaning_zh: n.警察部门,警方,警察,治安
vt.（警察、军队等）巡查,维护治安,（委员会等）监督,管制
example_en: The police are guardians of law and order.
example_zh: 警察是法律和秩序的护卫者.

meaning_zh: n.猪肉,〈美俚〉支持政党上台所分到的好处，政治分肥,〈古〉猪
example_en: Volunteers to go and bring in pork.'
example_zh: 不知有没有谁自告奋勇去搬些猪肉回来. ”

meaning_zh: n.邮政,邮件,邮班,职位,哨所,标志杆,终点标志,球门柱
v.邮寄,把…放入,派驻,站岗,张贴,发布,交付（保释金）
example_en: The bus stop is few yards below the post office.
example_zh: 公共汽车站在邮局向南几码的地方.

meaning_zh: v.把…定价为,贴标价,比较价格
example_en: The price is under first cost.
example_zh: 这价格低于成本.

example_en: The old ideas are a drag on progress.
example_zh: 旧观念是进步的障碍.

example_en: Most computer games provide some kind of wish fulfilment.
example_zh: 大部份电子游戏满足人们的某种愿望.

meaning_zh: adj.优质的,棒极了,内容严肃的（报纸）
example_en: If the equipment is not up to the agreed specifications and quality, we will undertake to replace them.
example_zh: 如果设备达不到议定的规格质量, 我们将负责调换.

meaning_zh: adj.快的，急速的,聪明的，凌厉的,灵活的,短时间做成的
n.（指甲下的）活肉,感情的中枢，感觉最敏锐的地方,要害，核心
example_en: The debater was quick on the draw.
example_zh: 辩论者思维敏捷.

meaning_zh: adv.很，相当,非常,的确,确实如此
example_en: This arrangement is quite satisfactory, so far as I am concerned.
example_zh: 就我来说, 这样的安排很好.

example_en: We require the cleanliness from our child.
example_zh: 我们要求孩子爱清洁.

meaning_zh: n.结果,胜利,分数，业绩,成效
example_en: Excessive dosage of this drug can result in injury to the liver.
example_zh: 这种药使用过量会损害肝脏.

meaning_zh: v.返回,归还,恢复,重提,回报，回应,回击,宣告,选举,产生
n.回来,归还,重现,收益,报告,回车键,击回球
example_en: An interval of a year elapsed before we were able to return.
example_zh: 隔了一年我们才得以返回.

meaning_zh: n.火箭（弹）,焰火，烟花,芝麻菜
v.猛增,快速移动,一举成名,用火箭攻击
example_en: Afterward the Rocket exchanges him Magic and trades rye, hereafter he changes to Nikesidui.
example_zh: 之后火箭队把他交换到魔术队并换来麦迪, 此后他又被转到尼克斯队.

example_en: Don't look down on the role women can play.
example_zh: 不要瞧不起妇女的作用.

meaning_zh: v.猛冲,急忙送,赶紧做,突袭
n.冲,匆忙,忙碌,情绪迸发,争做,高峰期,灯芯草,样片
example_en: Don't rush into marriage; you might regret it later.
example_zh: 不要匆匆忙忙结婚, 不然 你以后也许要后悔的.

meaning_zh: v.剪开( scissor的第三人称单数),作剪式移动（尤指腿）
example_en: Children must n't play with dangerous objects like sharp knives or scissors.
example_zh: 小孩子不可以玩危险的物品,例如锐利的刀子或剪刀.

meaning_zh: v.（使）分开/分离/分散,分割，划分,相隔，隔开,分居,区分
example_en: Can you separate butterflies from moths?
example_zh: 你能区别蝴蝶和飞蛾 吗 ?

meaning_zh: adj.严重的,令人担忧的,重要的,严肃的,认真的,庄重的,大量的
example_en: This is indeed a serious matter.
example_zh: 兹事体大.

meaning_zh: n.架子，搁板,突出的岩石，陆架
example_en: Would you please help me to put the shelf up; I can't do it myself.
example_zh: 你能帮我把书橱抬起来吗?我自己干不了.

meaning_zh: n.震惊，打击,令人震惊的事,冲击（力）,休克,触电,剧烈震动,减震器,浓密的一堆（头发）
example_en: The realisation that the murderer must have been a close friend came as a shock.
example_zh: 意识到杀人凶手一定是个密友,大家都很震惊.

example_en: I recognized him by the set of his head [ shoulder ].
example_zh: 我从他的头 [ 肩 ] 的姿态认出是他.

example_en: It is more important to be healthy than bony slim.
example_zh: 健康永远比皮包骨头好.

example_en: Let's think this out together — there must be a way to solve this.
example_zh: 让我们一起好好考虑一下吧,一定有办法能解决这件事情的.

meaning_zh: n.儿子,孩子,男性后裔,圣子（耶稣基督）
example_en: We find the mother featured in the son.
example_zh: 我们发现这个儿子很象她母亲.

meaning_zh: adj.闲置的， 空闲的,备用的,瘦（高）的
v.留出，剩余,省得,饶恕，使幸免,不吝惜（时间、金钱）
example_en: The hostess of the house reluctantly installed the two refugees in a spare room.
example_zh: 这家的女主人不情愿地把这两个难民安顿在一个空出来的房间里.

example_en: Hard work ennobles human spirit.
example_zh: 艰苦的工作使人精神变得高尚.

example_en: She has been on the stage for over thirty years.
example_zh: 她有30多年的艺龄.

meaning_zh: v.贴邮票于…,标记,用脚踩踏,捣碎
example_en: Stamp collecting and coin collecting are parallel hobbies.
example_zh: 集邮和收藏硬币是相似的爱好.

example_en: He volunteered to serve as the manager of our department store.
example_zh: 他自荐当我们商场的经理.

example_en: I felt a strange sense of elation.
example_zh: 我有一种异常的兴奋感觉.

example_en: We are not such fools as to believe him.
example_zh: 我们不是那样的蠢人,竟会相信他.

example_en: May I make bold to suggest that you were wrong to do so?
example_zh: 我斗胆说一句,这件事您做错了.

meaning_zh: n.建议,暗示,表明,些微,联想
example_en: The suggestion merits serious consideration.
example_zh: 该建议值得认真考虑.

meaning_zh: v.假定，设想,(根据所知)认为，推断,（婉转表达）我看，要不
example_en: It is a fallacy to suppose that riches always bring happiness.
example_zh: 认为财富总能带来幸福是一种错误的见解.

meaning_zh: vt.交给某人（任务）,使过于劳累
example_en: She performed the most challenging task without a mistake.
example_zh: 她毫无差错地完成了这一最富有挑战性的任务.

example_en: Do you know the optimum temperature for the growth of plants?
example_zh: 你知道庄稼生长的最佳温度 吗 ?

example_en: He has been ill most of the term.
example_zh: 这学期大部分时间他一直生病.

meaning_zh: vi.受试验,受测验,受考验,测得结果
example_en: In a consumer taste test, Coke went up against Pepsi.
example_zh: 在一次消费者品尝测验中, 可口可乐与百事可乐交锋了.

example_en: Thank you for your invaluable help.
example_zh: 谢谢你的非常宝贵的帮助.

meaning_zh: n.三分之一,三等学位（英国大学中低于平均水平的学位）
example_en: She seems to have camped up at the third act of the play.
example_zh: 她在第三幕中表演得似乎过火了.

meaning_zh: vt.& vi.发出隆隆声,轰隆隆地快速移动,使快速移动,怒喝
example_en: The thunder paniced the horse.
example_zh: 响雷使马惊慌.

meaning_zh: n.旅行者，观光客,〈美〉冬季到南部做工的流动工人
example_en: Please put me through to the tourist agency.
example_zh: 请挂旅行社.

meaning_zh: n.塔（楼）,(无线电或电视信号的)发射塔,高架子,立式机箱
v.（比周围的人或物)高出许多），屹立
example_en: The tower ordered the plane to taxi the full length of the runway.
example_zh: 塔台指挥人员命令该机在跑道上滑行全程.

example_en: From then on I began to treasure everything life grants us.
example_zh: 从那时起我开始珍惜生命给我们的任何东西.

example_en: She had heard the news-flash on a TV channel's news update.
example_zh: 她在一家电视台的新闻快讯中听到了这则简明新闻。

meaning_zh: n.孪生儿之一，双胞胎之一,两个相像的人或物之一,孪晶,双人床
vt.尤用于英国)使结成姊妹城市,使（两人或两事物）紧密结合,使偶合,使相连
adj.成对的,成双的,双重的,双联的
example_en: The sympathy between the twin brothers is so great that they often smile and cry at the same things.
example_zh: 这对孪生兄弟的共同情感非常强烈,他们常常对于同一事物要笑就一起笑,要哭就一起哭.

meaning_zh: adj.难看的,丑陋的,有敌意的,不祥的
example_en: Down deep in that ugly heap Marie Curie felt sure that her new element lay hidden.
example_zh: 就在那一堆丑陋难看的东西中,玛丽·居里夫人深信她的新元素蕴藏其中,不为人知.

example_en: His father is a member of the underground.
example_zh: 他父亲是一名地下组织的成员.

meaning_zh: n.综合性大学,大学人员,大学校舍
example_en: She was a scholarly woman who had specialized in Italian literature at university.
example_zh: 她是个学问精深的女人,她在大学里读的专业是意大利文学.

meaning_zh: adv.在上面，在高处,起床，起来,向上,由低到高
adj.向上的,上升的,竖立的，垂直的,举起的
vt.& vi.增加,加速,提高,举起，拿起
prep.在…的上端,向高处,沿…而去,向…上游
example_en: The stew must be boiled up before serving.
example_zh: 炖肉必须煮熟才能上桌.

meaning_zh: n.价值（观）,重要性，用途,划算程度,数值
example_en: When money falls in value, there is no encouragement to save.
example_zh: 货币贬值时, 就无法鼓励人们储蓄.

example_en: The news of rigged ballots has rubbed off much of the shine of their election victory.
example_zh: 他们操纵选票的消息使他们在选举中获得的胜利大为减色.

meaning_zh: n.（葬礼前后的）守夜，守灵,(航行中的船等留下的)尾流，航迹
example_en: Be quiet in case you wake the baby.
example_zh: 轻点儿,别吵醒婴儿.

example_en: The whole incident was recorded on film.
example_zh: 整个事件都记录在胶片上了.

meaning_zh: adj.宽的,普遍的,广阔的,张大的，开得很大的
example_en: The hypermarket stations had a wide selection of branded foods, clean toilets, friendly service and fast checkouts.
example_zh: 这家超大型连锁加油站有各种名牌食品 、 洁净的卫生间 、 友好的服务并且结帐迅速.

meaning_zh: n.妻子，太太,夫人，老婆,已婚妇女
example_en: That face called up in his mind the image of his end wife.
example_zh: 那张脸使他想起了他亡妻的形象.

meaning_zh: n.获胜的人,胜券在握,制胜的一记入球,成功的东西
example_en: We were eager to hear the announcement of the winner of the race.
example_zh: 我们急于想听到宣布赛跑优胜者名单.

meaning_zh: prep.缺乏，没有，不用,不和…一起,在没有(发生或做某事)的情况下
example_en: Meat spoils more quickly without preservatives.
example_zh: 不加防腐剂,肉会坏得快.

example_en: Have we got to the zoo yet?
example_zh: 我们到动物园了 吗 ?

example_en: His native musical ability impressed his teacher.
example_zh: 他天生的音乐才能给老师留下了深刻印象.

meaning_zh: adj.缺席的,不在场的,心不在焉的,（父或母）不和子女一起住的
example_en: He's the only one absent; everybody else is here.
example_zh: 别人都来了,单单他没来.

example_en: We are justly proud of our new achievement.
example_zh: 我们有充分的理由为我们的新成就感到骄傲.

meaning_zh: n.行动，行为,诉讼,作用,功能,战斗,情节,动作片,令人激动的事
v.采取行动,确保处理(某事)
example_en: A cause of action has accrued when the right to sue has become vested.
example_zh: 起诉的理由在控告权被赋予后随之存在.

example_en: I'd admire to go.
example_zh: 我很想去.

meaning_zh: n.有利条件,优势,优点，好处
example_en: The fashion sets her figure off to advantage.
example_zh: 那件时装把她的身段衬托得更加优美.

meaning_zh: v.劝告,建议，提供咨询,通知
example_en: After fifteen years of teaching, he was seconded to the Ministry of Education to advise them on school planning.
example_zh: 任教15年后, 他被调到教育部协助制定教育规划.

example_en: The assembly voted to delay the legislation to allow further consultation to take place.
example_zh: 议会投票决定暂缓立法以便进一步磋商.

meaning_zh: v.是（be 的第一人称单数现在时）
example_en: I shall have to read up on this subject if I am to give a talk about it.
example_zh: 如果我准备做一次关于这课题的讲座,我就必须把它彻底研究一番.

meaning_zh: prep.为…所围绕,在…中,与…在一起,是…之一,与…一样
example_en: These difficulties are general among people of his age.
example_zh: 这些困难在他那个年龄的人中普遍存在.

meaning_zh: v.看来，好像,出现,出演,起源，首次使用,出版，广播,演出,抵达,出庭
example_en: Babies of two months old do not appear to be reluctant to enter the water.
example_zh: 两个月的婴儿并不显得不肯下水.

meaning_zh: v.争论，争吵,辩论，讨论,论证,表明,主张，认为,不承认
example_en: It is not always reliable to argue by analogy.
example_zh: 靠类推法论证并不总是可靠的.

meaning_zh: n.文章,论文,报道,条约,物品,冠词
example_en: A clerk booked down details of every article handed in.
example_zh: 一个职员把交进来的每一件东西详细地登记下来.

example_en: This thought kept me awake all night.
example_zh: 这种顾虑使我通宵未能合眼.

example_en: The thugs beat him senseless with a baseball bat.
example_zh: 暴徒用棒球棒把他打得失去了知觉.

meaning_zh: n.好处,优势,福利费,保险金,慈善活动
example_en: Moderate exercise will benefit you.
example_zh: 适当的锻炼对你有好处.

example_en: Botany, zoology, biochemistry and molecular biology, cell biology, microbiology, genetics, fermentation engineering.
example_zh: 植物学, 动物学, 生物化学与分子生物学, 细胞生物学, 微生物学, 遗传学, 发酵工程.

example_en: I saw this pretty blouse and bought it on sight.
example_zh: 我一见这件非常漂亮的女衬衫便马上买下.

example_en: Mr. Brown has held 500 shares in the shipping company.
example_zh: 布朗先生持有该家航运公司的500份股份.

meaning_zh: n.商业，生意,商务，公事,业务量，营业额,商业机构，企业，商店,职责,要点,事情,消费
example_en: Government officials who travel on business are given traveling allowances.
example_zh: 因公出差的政府官员享有出差补贴.

meaning_zh: n.漫画，幽默画,动画片,草图
example_en: Yes, I have learned a lot from this cartoon, his optimism inspired me.
example_zh: 好的, 我从这部漫画里也学到很多, 他的乐观精神鼓舞了我.

meaning_zh: adj.中心的,中央的,核心的,处于中心的
example_en: A huge bomb blast rocked central London last night.
example_zh: 昨晚一次剧烈的炸弹爆炸震动了伦敦市中心.

example_en: Britain formed a close alignment with Egypt in the last century.
example_zh: 英国在上个世纪与埃及结成了紧密的联盟.

example_en: It is important to challenge society's preconceptions about disabled people.
example_zh: 质疑社会对残疾人的成见极为重要.

meaning_zh: n.作弊者,欺骗手段,作弊软件
example_en: He looks honest, but he is a cheat.
example_zh: 他看上去很诚实, 但实际上是个骗子.

meaning_zh: n.化学,化学组成,（两人之间）吸引
example_en: This hazy " phlogiston theory, " this erroneous conception of burning, led chemistry along a completely false trail.
example_zh: 这个莫名其妙的 “ 燃素论 ”,对燃烧做了错误的理解, 把化学扯上了一条完全错误道路.

meaning_zh: n.琐事，令人厌烦的任务,家务活
example_en: Peeling bags of potatoes is really a chore.
example_zh: 削一袋又一袋洋芋皮真是苦差使.

meaning_zh: n.大学,学院,技术专科学校,高等专科学校,学院师生,公学,学会
example_en: The team was pointing for the game with the neighbouring college.
example_zh: 球队正在准备迎接与邻近那所大学的比赛.

meaning_zh: adj.常见的,共有的,共同的,普通的,平凡的,众所周知的,粗俗的
example_en: In this matter we must place the common cause above all else.
example_zh: 在这件事情上,我们必须把共同事业放在高于一切的位置上.

meaning_zh: n.社会（团体）,共有,(生物)群落
example_en: He refuses to join any community.
example_zh: 他不参加任何团体.

example_en: The price must be right in order to compete internationally.
example_zh: 为了在国际上竞争,定价必须适当.

example_en: She steered the conversation to more general topics.
example_zh: 她把谈话引向更为一般性的话题.

meaning_zh: adj.正确的,恰当的,符合公认准则的,得体的
v.改正，纠正,批改，修改,指出错误
example_en: Please correct any errors that you find.
example_zh: 若有差错,请斧正.

meaning_zh: v.咳（嗽）,突然发出刺激的声音
example_en: The cough seemed to rack his body.
example_zh: 他咳得全身震动.

example_en: His behavior under fire approved him a man of courage.
example_zh: 他在战火中的表现证明他是一个勇敢的人.

meaning_zh: adj.有创造力的,创作的，创新的
n.搞创作的人,创意，创作素材
example_en: Develop creative thinking and determining future trend of modern children.
example_zh: 培养创造思考,掌握未来的世纪儿童.

meaning_zh: n.人群,观众,一伙人,老百姓,群众
v.聚集在…,逼近,（使）拥挤,涌上心头
example_en: The crowd tingled with excitement.
example_zh: 群众大为兴奋.

meaning_zh: n.女儿,产物，后代,（某地的）妇女,[生]子代
example_en: He introduced Mary as his daughter.
example_zh: 他介绍说玛丽是他女儿.

meaning_zh: v.装饰,装潢,粉刷,糊墙纸,装点,美化,授予勋章
example_en: She opened the door for me and threw herself in my arms, screaming joyously and demanding that we decorate the tree immediately.
example_zh: 她打开门,直扑我的怀抱, 欣喜地喊叫着要马上装饰圣诞树.

meaning_zh: adj.数码的,数字显示的,脚趾的
example_en: With Digital Universe, Emmart and Hayden Planetarium can take viewers deep into space on interstellar missions.
example_zh: 随着数字宇宙, 埃马尔特和海登天文馆可以考虑到星际空间飞行任务观众深.

meaning_zh: n.方向，趋势,动向,方面,目标,管理，指示,用法说明,导演指导
example_en: He realized that he was heading in the wrong direction.
example_zh: 他意识到走错了方向.

example_en: The words hardly permit doubt.
example_zh: 这些话不容置疑.

example_en: I was on duty during the morning watch.
example_zh: 我值早班.

example_en: The rule is still in effect.
example_zh: 本规则仍然有效.

meaning_zh: n.努力,吃力,有组织的行动,费力的事
example_en: He did the work without effort.
example_zh: 他很轻松地就把工作做好了.

example_en: The money has to be divided among the eighteen Incorruptibles.
example_zh: 应该把这笔钱让那十八位拒腐蚀的大人分了.

meaning_zh: adj.用电的,电的,通电的,扣人心弦的
example_en: Electric current is often powerful enough to kill a man.
example_zh: 电流常强得足以致命.

example_en: This radar is operated by an electronic pulse.
example_zh: 这台雷达依靠电子脉冲来操作.

example_en: Hearing that there was an emergency case, the doctor put down his chopsticks and left at once.
example_zh: 听说有急诊, 医生撂下筷子就走.

meaning_zh: v.鼓励,使有希望,劝说,促进
example_en: Economic policy is liberalized to encourage initiatives in production.
example_zh: 放宽经济政策以鼓励生产的积极性.

example_en: They revealed to me that the experiment had failed.
example_zh: 他们向我透露试验失败了.

meaning_zh: adj.最后的,末了的,不可更改的
n.决赛,大学毕业考试,期终考试
example_en: Her Olimpic experience gave her a big advantage over the other contestants for the final victory.
example_zh: 她的奥运会参赛经历使她比起其他竞技对手在争取最后获胜上具有很大的优势.

example_en: They finally came together after years of estrangement.
example_zh: 在多年不和之后,他们终于言归于好了.

meaning_zh: n.消防队员,[矿]救火员，爆破工,司炉工
example_en: The newspapers acclaimed the fireman a hero.
example_zh: 该报拥戴这位消防员为英雄.

example_en: He was well acquainted with the literature of France, Germany and Holland.
example_zh: 他对于法国、德国和荷兰的文学了如指掌。

example_en: There's some ice in the fridge.
example_zh: 冰箱里有些冰块儿.

meaning_zh: n.青蛙,〈侮辱〉青蛙佬，对法国人的蔑称,[交]铁路辙叉,饰扣，挂环
example_en: Quick unexpected frog goes Plop!
example_zh: 突然,一只青蛙扑通跳了进来.

meaning_zh: adj.全体的,一般的,普通的,大体的,广泛的,整体的,首席的
example_en: She steered the conversation to more general topics.
example_zh: 她把谈话引向更为一般性的话题.

meaning_zh: adj.金（黄）色的,金质的,美好的
example_en: The directors will each get a large golden handshake and a pension.
example_zh: 所有的经理都会得到丰厚的退职金和养老费.

example_en: Grandfather is quite old and a bit hunchbacked.
example_zh: 祖父年纪大了,背有点驼.

example_en: Move over and let your grandmother sit down.
example_zh: 挪开些,让你外婆坐下来.

meaning_zh: n.卫兵,看守,列车长,保护装置,防守姿势,警卫队,后卫,哨锋
example_en: I'll mount guard over the luggage while you get the ticket.
example_zh: 你去买票,我来看管行李.

example_en: I hate to disillusion him.
example_zh: 我真不想使他的幻想破灭.

example_en: He used his headache as a pretext for not going to school.
example_zh: 他借口头疼而不去上学.

meaning_zh: adj.诚实的,坦诚的,真诚的,勤劳的
example_en: Let's be brutally honest about this: you haven't a hope of succeeding.
example_zh: 虽然有点儿残忍,但 老实 说,你没有成功的希望.

meaning_zh: n.主人,东道主,节目主持人,主机,寄主,大量,祭品,圣体
v.作为主人组织,主办活动,主持,存储网站
example_en: That would be reversal of the order of host and guest.
example_zh: 这就主客颠倒了.

example_en: Four days after setting out , while the Titantic was sailing across the icy waters of the North Atlantic, a huge iceberg was suddenly spotted by a lookout.
example_zh: 启航四天后, 泰坦尼克号在穿过北大西洋多冰的海域时, 了望员突然发现了一个巨大的冰山.

meaning_zh: adj.人的,人本性的,通人情的
example_en: Teachers are engineers of human soul.
example_zh: 教师是人类灵魂的工程师.

meaning_zh: n.丈夫,〈英〉管家,〈古〉节俭的管理人,船舶管理人
vt.节俭地使用,〈罕〉做…的丈夫
example_en: She guessed that the letter had something to do with her husband.
example_zh: 她猜想这封信与她丈夫有关.

example_en: There is a tree in front of the house.
example_zh: 房子前面有一棵树。

example_en: The phases of the moon include the new and the full moon.
example_zh: 月相包括新月和满月.

example_en: Sugar is added to the wine during fermentation to increase the alcohol level.
example_zh: 发酵时在葡萄酒里加糖以提高酒精浓度.

meaning_zh: pron.(it的反身形式),它自己，它本身,自身，本身
example_en: The bent strip can straighten up by itself.
example_zh: 这弯曲的金属片自己可以变直.

meaning_zh: v.慢跑，慢步长跑,轻推，轻撞
example_en: He celebrated with a shrug and a jog in front of the now silent Levski fans.
example_zh: 对此球的庆祝,他只是耸一耸肩,然后在沉静的列夫斯基球迷面前一路慢跑回本队半场.

example_en: " There you are — like a knife through butter,'said the demonstrator as the powered shovel swung back with its load.
example_zh: 当动力铲带着铲起的东西转回来时,示范的人说, “ 你瞧是不是,多么容易. ”

example_en: Do you know Chinese kung fu?
example_zh: 你知道中国功夫吗？

example_en: I used my thumbnail to tighten the screw on my lamp.
example_zh: 我用拇指指甲把台灯上的螺钉拧紧了。

example_en: He is studying law.
example_zh: 他在研读法学.

meaning_zh: v.在…前面走,引路,连通,通至,领先,领导,导致,使得,引导,过（某种生活）引出,开牌
n.领先的地位,超前量,榜样,线索,主角,狗绳,导线,铅,铅笔芯,子弹
example_en: His jokes about woman drivers went down like a lead balloon.
example_zh: 他讲了不少女人驾车的笑话,但没人笑.

example_en: Lightning streaks from cloud to cloud.
example_zh: 闪电划过朵朵乌云.

example_en: Their ears were still attuned to the sounds of the London suburb.
example_zh: 他们依然很熟悉伦敦市郊的喧闹声。

example_en: He looked after sheep.
example_zh: 他放羊。

meaning_zh: n.主人,专家,能手,男教师,（已故）艺术大师,船长,硕士学位,母带,院长,长老,少爷
adj.熟练的,最重要的,原始拷贝的
example_en: She is master of the situation.
example_zh: 她控制着局面.

example_en: We all agree in adopting the new teaching method.
example_zh: 我们一致同意采取新的教学方法.

example_en: Knock the mould against the table to dislodge the mooncake.
example_zh: 把模子往桌上敲,来移动月饼.

meaning_zh: adj.音乐的,有音乐天赋的,悦耳的
example_en: The musical theater company is about to launch a new performer on the musical world.
example_zh: 这家音乐公司即将向音乐界推出一位新人.

example_en: The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water.
example_zh: 那球重重地打在他身上,他几乎掉下水去.

example_en: Neither pen nor pencil can express.
example_zh: 并非笔墨所能形容.

example_en: It's nineteen hour Beijing time.
example_zh: 现在是北京时间19点.

example_en: He received four years of normal education at college.
example_zh: 他在大学受了四年正规教育.

meaning_zh: adj.北方的，北部的,来自北方的,北风
example_en: The map of the heavens showed all the northern constellations.
example_zh: 这份天体图标明了北半部所有的星座.

meaning_zh: pron.没有什么,无关紧要的事物/人,零,不值钱
example_en: We can't get unwary just because nothing unusual has cropped up.
example_zh: 不能因为没发生什么问题就麻痹大意起来.

example_en: Nowadays, one's voice, appearance, or movement can be recorded onto tape or film.
example_zh: 现在一个人的声音 、 表情或者动作都可以录在磁带或胶片上.

example_en: A: Can you help me with this? B: Of course, I can.
example_zh: “你能帮我搞定这个么？” “当然能。”

example_en: The post office is opposite ( to ) the station.
example_zh: 邮局在车站的对面.

example_en: Their house is in close proximity to ours.
example_zh: 他们的房子很接近我们的.

meaning_zh: n.小包,信息包,邮船,大笔款项
example_en: It'says on the packet that these crisps contain no additives.
example_zh: 包装上说这些炸薯片不含添加剂.

example_en: The medicine is used to assuage pain.
example_zh: 这种药用来止痛.

meaning_zh: n.烙饼，薄煎饼,粉饼,[航]平降，平坠
example_en: Most of the landscape in the Fens is as flat as a pancake.
example_zh: 菲恩斯的大部分地形都是极平坦的.

meaning_zh: v.执行,起…作用,演出,表现（好 / 不好）
example_en: I have a duty to perform.
example_zh: 我有一种义务要尽.

meaning_zh: adj.个人的,亲自的,人际的,个别的,针对个人的,身体的,私人的
example_en: The Chinese make a point of their personal honor.
example_zh: 中国人特别重视个人荣誉.

meaning_zh: n.药丸,口服避孕药,讨厌的人
example_en: So are the advantages of taking the blue pill?
example_zh: 那么吞下蓝色药片的好处何在?

meaning_zh: n.（男）警察，警员,看守矿井的人,[化] 淀帚
example_en: The policeman noted down every word he said.
example_zh: 警察把他所说的每句话都记了下来.

example_en: The problem of pollution arises along with the rapid development of industry.
example_zh: 随着工业的迅速发展,产生了污染问题.

example_en: The father bear said, " Who has eaten some of my porridge? "
example_zh: 熊爸爸说: “ 谁吃了我的一些粥? ”

meaning_zh: n.位置,姿势,地位,职位,名次,处境,立场,阵地
example_en: Mr. White occupies an important position in the Ministry of Education.
example_zh: 怀特先生在教育部里担任要职.

example_en: We accorded the boy due praise.
example_zh: 我们给了孩子适当的表扬.

meaning_zh: v.压,按,把…塞入,紧握（手或臂）,推搡着移动,催促,坚持,压平,熨烫,压榨,压制,用力踩,极力要求,困扰,硬给
n.报纸,新闻记者,印刷机,出版社,榨汁机,挤压,拥挤的人群,衣柜
example_en: The press branded him a liar.
example_zh: 报界给他加上了说谎者的臭名.

meaning_zh: adj.私用的,私营的,个人的,秘密的,私人的,隐私的,僻静的,内敛的,间接收入的
example_en: She tried to prevent her work from encroaching too far on her private life.
example_zh: 她尽力避免工作过多地影响她的私生活.

example_en: He missed the first prize by a whisker.
example_zh: 他和头奖擦肩而过.

meaning_zh: n.意图，计划,情势需要,重要意义,意志
example_en: We spoke to little purpose — his mind was clearly made up already.
example_zh: 我们说的话几乎不起作用,他显然已下定决心了.

example_en: Remind me to buy another hairspray when I'm in town, would you?
example_zh: 在我进城时提醒我再买一罐喷发定型剂, 好 吗 ?

example_en: His reply was highly enigmatic.
example_zh: 他的回答高深莫测.

meaning_zh: adj.富有的,肥沃的,丰富多彩的,油腻的
example_en: He is rich, but he is still avid of more money.
example_zh: 他很富有, 但他还想贪图更多的钱.

meaning_zh: n.卷,管,面包卷,翻滚,摇晃,赘肉,名册,隆隆声,掷骰子
v.卷，摇，转,（使）滚动,翻转,压平,发出持续声音,启动,缓缓行进,抢劫
example_en: Our dog loves a roll on the grass.
example_zh: 我们的狗喜爱在草地上打滚.

meaning_zh: n.玫瑰,粉红色,蔷薇（花）,粉红色的葡萄酒
v.起义（ rise的过去式）,升起,（数量）增加,休会
example_en: They refused to be enslaved and rose in struggle.
example_zh: 他们不甘心受奴役而起来斗争了.

meaning_zh: n.卫星,人造卫星,卫星国,卫星区
example_en: The satellite was launched into orbit around the moon.
example_zh: 卫星被射入环绕月球的轨道.

meaning_zh: n.地点，现场,场面,镜头,圈子，坛,景色,风景画,争吵
example_en: She doesn't like to make a scene before strangers.
example_zh: 当着生人的面,她不愿大吵大闹.

meaning_zh: vt.& vi.关闭,合上,打烊,闭上
example_en: You don't know the facts, so keep your mouth shut!
example_zh: 你不了解情况, 别多嘴!

example_en: Every organ of state must apply the principle of efficient and simple administration.
example_zh: 国家机关必须实行精简的原则.

example_en: The soldiers were walking in single file.
example_zh: 战士们排成一列纵队前进.

example_en: Now it's six sixteen.
example_zh: 现在时间6 点16 分。

example_en: Some rocks are his mouth and eyes, two sticks are his arms, we a snowman now!
example_zh: 第四步,用胡萝卜当作雪人的鼻子,石头作嘴和眼睛, 两只木棍作胳膊, 我们现在就堆出一个雪人了!

example_en: Economic conditions may lie responsible for the creation of social unrest.
example_zh: 经济状况可能是产生社会不安的根源.

example_en: The slaves of the old society have become the masters of the new society.
example_zh: 旧社会的奴隶变成了新社会的主人.

example_en: We found him to be the right sort of timber.
example_zh: 我们发现他是真正的人才.

meaning_zh: vt.& vi.讲，谈,演说,从某种观点来说
example_en: I am honoured to be asked to speak.
example_zh: 我应邀发言,不胜荣幸.

example_en: The boy's manner of speech jarred on the teacher, who came from a different part of the country.
example_zh: 那孩子说话的神态令那位来自外地的老师感到不舒服.

example_en: We're going to steal some apples from farmer Jones's orchard. Why won't you come with us? Lost your bottle?
example_zh: 我们要去农民琼斯的果园里偷苹果, 你为什么不和我们一起去? 你害怕了?

example_en: A stranger who is kind is a relative; an unkind relative is a stranger.
example_zh: 善良的陌生人是亲戚, 冷漠的亲戚是陌生人.

meaning_zh: n.表面，表层,台面，操作台,外表
example_en: A gentle wind disturbed the surface of the water.
example_zh: 微风拂动水面.

meaning_zh: n.体系，制度,系统,网（络）,身体
example_en: Since the new management system was put into effect, the production of this factory has increased tremendously.
example_zh: 自从实行新的管理制度以来,这个厂的生产有了很大发展.

example_en: Let's take part in the triumphal chorus.
example_zh: 让我们去参加凯歌大合唱吧。

example_en: There was a lot of talent in this city.
example_zh: 在这个城市里有很多人才.

meaning_zh: v.轻敲/拍/叩,利用，开发,窃听,委任，指定,敲节拍
n.龙头，阀门,轻击/拍/敲,电话窃听
example_en: He has money on tap.
example_zh: 他手头有现金.

meaning_zh: adj.非常严重的,可怕的,(感觉或看起来)病得很重的,劣质的,很糟糕的,十足的
example_en: We often read in novels how a seemingly respectable person or family has some terrible secret which has been concealed from strangers for years.
example_zh: 表面上道貌岸然的人或有声望的家庭,却有着骇人听闻,多年不让人知道的秘密,这样的事情我们经常在小说里读到.

meaning_zh: n.文本，原文,课文，教科书,主题,版本
example_en: The teacher asked the students to copy out the text.
example_zh: 老师让同学们抄写课文.

example_en: There was a careful avoidance of the sensitive topic in the scholastic circles.
example_zh: 学术界小心地避开那个敏感的话题.

meaning_zh: v.总数达,计算…的总和,彻底毁坏
example_en: The king's escort total 50 men.
example_zh: 国王的警卫队总数达50人.

example_en: A lie which is half a truth is ever the blackest of lies.
example_zh: 真假参半的谎言最险恶.

example_en: He was pinned against the fence by a boy twice his size; he could hardly breathe.
example_zh: 他被一个身材两倍于他的男孩按在篱笆上, 喘不过气来.

example_en: The universe seems infinite.
example_zh: 宇宙似乎是无限的.

meaning_zh: adj.有用的，有益的，有帮助的,令人满意的
example_en: Shoemaking is a useful trade.
example_zh: 做鞋是一种有用的手艺.

example_en: The children wait impatiently for the vacation.
example_zh: 孩子们焦急地等待着假期的来临.

meaning_zh: adj.有价值的,宝贵的,贵重的，值钱的
example_en: Ordinary people would then be able to use them to obtain valuable information.
example_zh: 那时平常的人便能运用它们去获取宝贵的信息.

example_en: The cat wakes up.
example_zh: 猫醒了。

meaning_zh: conj. 无论何时,每当,任何时间（都行）,不知什么时候
adv.（用于问句）究竟什么时候
example_en: Our street floods whenever we have rain.
example_zh: 我们的街道一下雨就淹水.

example_en: The dabbler in knowledge chatters away ; the wise man stays silent.
example_zh: 一瓶子不响,半瓶子晃荡.

example_en: He was so worried that sweat began to pour down his face.
example_zh: 他很着急,汗水沿着他的面颊直淌下来.

meaning_zh: adj.价值，值…钱,值得,拥有…价值的财产
example_en: The house had been ransacked of all that was worth anything.
example_zh: 屋子里所有值钱的东西都被抢去了.

example_en: This cake tastes yummy.
example_zh: 这个蛋糕真好吃。

example_en: We won't be able to tell what skills the man has until we try him out.
example_zh: 要等试用一个时期以后,我们才能知道这人有什么专长.

example_en: The manufacturers in some countries dumped their surplus commodities abroad.
example_zh: 一些国家的制造商向国外倾销过剩产品.

example_en: If the new actor is no good, kick him out.
example_zh: 如果那个新来的演员不怎么样就让他走.

meaning_zh: v.影响,使感动,（疾病）感染,假装
example_en: But sooner rather than later, this aerial vehicle technology will affect all of our lives.
example_zh: 但是不久以后, 这种空中运载器技术就将影响到我们生活的方方面面.

example_en: The aim of poetry is to please.
example_zh: 诗的目的在于使人愉悦.

example_en: Although the two countries were officially at peace, fighting continued.
example_zh: 尽管两国公开表示和平共处, 但战斗还在继续.

meaning_zh: vi.（用于第二人称单复数现在时，第一、三人称复数现在时）是
example_en: The world breaks everyone, and afterward, many are stronger at the broken places.
example_zh: 生活总是让我们遍体鳞伤，但到后来，那些受伤的地方会变得更坚强。

meaning_zh: v.攻击,抨击，打击,（疾病）发作，侵袭,着手处理
n.进攻,冲击，抨击,处理,（疾病）发作，侵袭,进攻队员,损害，伤害
example_en: We will not attack unless we are attacked; if we are attacked, we will certainly counterattack.
example_zh: 人不犯我,我不犯人; 人若犯我, 我必犯人.

meaning_zh: v.出席，参加,经常去（某地）,看护,伴随,专心
example_en: Will it be inconvenient for him to attend that meeting?
example_zh: 他参加那次会议会不方便 吗 ?

meaning_zh: n.出身，背景,底色,幕后,背景音
example_en: She has a lot of power, but likes to remain in the background.
example_zh: 她掌握不少权力, 但喜欢退居幕后.

meaning_zh: n.美（丽）,美人,美好的东西,典型的例子,优点
example_en: It is a temple of rare architectural beauty.
example_zh: 论建筑之美,那是一座极少有的寺院.

meaning_zh: v.表现,举止得体,作出反应
example_en: You are asking for trouble when you behave in that way.
example_zh: 你那种行为是自找苦吃.

example_en: As soon as the bell rang, the captain gave orders to cast off, and the voyage began.
example_zh: 铃一响, 船长下令解缆绳, 航行就开始了.

example_en: The bus stop is few yards below the post office.
example_zh: 公共汽车站在邮局向南几码的地方.

meaning_zh: prep.在…另一边,超过，超出,晚于,无法理解
example_en: Her beauty is beyond compare.
example_zh: 她无比美丽.

example_en: They made frequent checks on his respiration, pulse and blood.
example_zh: 他们经常检查他的呼吸 、 脉搏和血液.

example_en: Be vigilant against the danger of enemy agents infiltrating the government and boring from within.
example_zh: 要警惕敌特渗入政府内部进行暗中破坏.

example_en: The more the boss tries to get rid of her, the more she digs in.
example_zh: 老板越是想开除她, 她就越是拼命保住自己的地位.

meaning_zh: n.底部，尽头,最末位置,臀部,套装的裙（裤）
example_en: The river slows on the flat bottom.
example_zh: 河水在平坦的河床上减慢了流速.

meaning_zh: v.鞠躬,低头,屈服于,使沮丧
example_en: He shot the arrow from the bow.
example_zh: 他拉弓把箭射了出去.

meaning_zh: n.（头）脑,智力,出谋划策者，聪明的人
example_en: He suffered from suffusion of blood on the brain.
example_zh: 他患脑溢血.

meaning_zh: v.呼吸，呼气,低声说,透气,充满
example_en: He was pinned against the fence by a boy twice his size; he could hardly breathe.
example_zh: 他被一个身材两倍于他的男孩按在篱笆上, 喘不过气来.

meaning_zh: v.谨慎花钱,把…编入预算,为…做出安排
example_en: The Ministry of Finance consistently overestimated its budget deficits.
example_zh: 财政部一贯高估预算赤字.

example_en: There the incidence of the cancer of the oesophagus was suspected to be pretty high.
example_zh: 估计那里的食道癌发病率相当高.

meaning_zh: n.情况,事例,事实,病例,案件,诉讼,辩词,盒，箱,（语法）格
example_en: In case you need something, please don't hesitate to ask me.
example_zh: 如果你需要什么东西, 请不客气地对我说.

example_en: Carnival is a traditional time of celebration before the Christian season of Lent.
example_zh: 嘉年华会是一个在四旬斋的基督教季节前的传统的庆祝节日.

meaning_zh: adj.肯定的,无疑的,轻微的,某个，某些，某位
pron.某些（不提及人或事物的名称时用）
example_en: The witnesses were each perfectly certain of what they said.
example_zh: 证人们个个对自己所说的话十分肯定.

meaning_zh: adj.典型的，经典的,典雅的，古朴的,老式的,第一流的,不足为奇的
n.经典作品,典范,古典文化
example_en: The football match was a classic.
example_zh: 那场足球比赛堪称典范.

meaning_zh: v.使发出咔嗒声,(用鼠标)点击,豁然开朗,（与…）一见如故,受到欢迎,配合默契
n.咔哒声,（鼠标）点击,吸气声
example_en: Click play on the Time Slider's playback control to play back the animation.
example_zh: 单击播放按钮回放控制动画.

example_en: Ability to communicate both positive and negative information in a constructive manner.
example_zh: 以一种积极的态度传达正面和负面信息的能力.

meaning_zh: n.公司,商号,剧团,连队,陪伴,宾客,在一起的一群人
example_en: Mr. Brown has held 500 shares in the shipping company.
example_zh: 布朗先生持有该家航运公司的500份股份.

example_en: Ladies remove their hats in a concert.
example_zh: 女士们在音乐会上脱下帽子.

meaning_zh: v.认为，考虑,体谅，顾及,端详
example_en: Do you consider contributions to the village funds a duty or a pleasure?
example_zh: 你把款捐给村庄作为基金,看作是义务还是乐事?

meaning_zh: n.统治,控制（力）,克制,管理,限制,控制按钮,检查站/人员,对照标准
v.指挥,控制,限定,限制,阻止蔓延,抑制
example_en: The control unit decoded the 18 bits.
example_zh: 控制器对这18位字进行了译码.

meaning_zh: n.曲奇饼, 网络饼干（记录上网用户信息的软件）
example_en: Shortbread is a short crumbly cookie.
example_zh: 脆饼干是一种薄的、松脆的饼干.

example_en: Gunpowder, dynamite and gun cotton are explosives.
example_zh: 黑色火药 、 甘油炸药和强棉药都是炸药.

meaning_zh: v.敢,向…挑战,问…有没有胆量（做某事）
example_en: How dare you? Take your hand off me at once.
example_zh: 放肆! 马上把你的手挪开.

example_en: You may depend on their support.
example_zh: 你可依靠他们的支持.

meaning_zh: n.词典,字典,专业词典,电子词典
example_en: We are working all round the clock to finish this dictionary!
example_zh: 我们在为完成这本词典而昼夜不停地工作着!

meaning_zh: adj.笔直的，径直的,直接的,最近的,正好的,亲自的,坦率的,嫡系的
v.把…指向，指示,管理，监督,针对,为…指路,领导,执导(电影等),
example_en: The army is now under the direct command of General Barton.
example_zh: 陆军现在由巴顿将军直接指挥.

meaning_zh: n.距离,遥远，久远,疏远,远方,冷淡
example_en: I seemed to hear a voice in the distance.
example_zh: 我好象听到远处有说话声.

meaning_zh: n.美元,一元纸[硬]币,金钱,财富
example_en: I'll bet my bottom dollar that the train will be late again.
example_zh: 我敢打赌,火车又将晚点了.

meaning_zh: n.龙，龙船,[D-][天文学]天龙（星座）,[口语、贬义]脾气暴躁的人
example_en: Dragon born dragon, chellocken born chellocken, mouse son can make hole!
example_zh: 龙生龙, 凤生凤, 耗子的儿子会打洞!

meaning_zh: adj.积极主动的,精力旺盛的,剧烈的
example_en: You do look fresh and energetic.
example_zh: 啊,是你呀!你的确看起来容光焕发,精神饱满.

example_en: The companies are pouring trillions of yen into biotechnology research, especially for pharmaceuticals and new seeds.
example_zh: 这些公司将大量资金投入生物工艺学研究, 尤其是药品和新种子方面.

example_en: Kaspar had spoken know-ledgeably about the state of agriculture in Europe.
example_zh: 卡斯帕对欧洲农业状况发表了一番颇有见地的见解。

meaning_zh: n.交换,交谈,争吵,货币兑换,互访,交易大厅
example_en: I should like to exchange a few words with you in confidence.
example_zh: 我想私下和你交换点意见.

example_en: Excuse me, where can I buy men' s shirts?
example_zh: 劳驾，我在哪儿能买到男式衬衫？

example_en: Mind that your children don't catch the flu.
example_zh: 小心别让你孩子传上流感.

meaning_zh: v.集中,调焦,聚焦,集中光束
n.焦点,中心点,聚焦点,震源
example_en: Let's focus our attention on the main problem and not get bogged down in minor issues.
example_zh: 抓主要问题,不要被枝节问题牵掣住.

example_en: Better a witty fool man than a foolish wit.
example_zh: 宁做聪明的傻子,不做愚蠢的聪明人.

meaning_zh: v.强迫,强行,把…强加给,用力推动
n.暴力,力量,影响力,(物理学)力,风力级数,军事力量,警察机关
example_en: We had to use force to get into the house.
example_zh: 我们不得不强行进屋.

meaning_zh: adj.外国的,外交的,异质的,陌生的
example_en: A foreign language cannot be learned rapidly, it must be learned step by step.
example_zh: 外语并非在短时间内就能学会, 学外语是一个循序渐进的过程.

meaning_zh: adv.向前，提前,有进展地,向将来,拨快地
adj.向前的，前面的,鲁莽的,未来的
example_en: I look forward to hearing from you in the near future.
example_zh: 我盼望着不久收到你的信.

example_en: We found him to be the right sort of timber.
example_zh: 我们发现他是真正的人才.

meaning_zh: n.气体,[矿业] 瓦斯,汽油,毒气
example_en: They hiked gas rates.
example_zh: 他们提高了煤气价格.

meaning_zh: v.聚集,收集,搜集,收割,理解,逐渐增加,集中,给…打褶
example_en: I shall have to gather myself together to face the whole board of directors.
example_zh: 我得冷静下来以对付整个董事会.

meaning_zh: n.先生,绅士,有身份地位的人
example_en: Are you the gentleman introduced in the letter?
example_zh: 你就是信中引荐的那位先生 吗 ?

example_en: She doesn't give up easily.
example_zh: 她做任何事都不轻易放弃。

example_en: Goodbye for now; I'll be in touch.
example_zh: 现在要告别了, 我会同你联系的.

meaning_zh: v.获得学位,授予学位文凭,中学毕业,晋升
example_en: I am enrolled in the graduate division of the Department of Education at Beijing Normal University.
example_zh: 我是北京师范大学教育系的在读研究生.

example_en: Grandpa Zhang grows several pots of violets in the overhead terrace.
example_zh: 张爷爷在骑楼上养了几盆紫罗兰.

meaning_zh: n.发展，增加,成长,新生发的植株,肿瘤，赘生物,产物
example_en: Do you know the optimum temperature for the growth of plants?
example_zh: 你知道庄稼生长的最佳温度 吗 ?

meaning_zh: n.过道，走廊,大厅，前厅,娱乐中心，会所
example_en: Speak louder so the people in the hall can all hear you.
example_zh: 大声点讲,以便大厅里的人都能听清.

example_en: It is a fallacy to suppose that riches always bring happiness.
example_zh: 认为财富总能带来幸福是一种错误的见解.

meaning_zh: adv.几乎不,几乎没有,很难,刚刚,并不
example_en: He was pinned against the fence by a boy twice his size; he could hardly breathe.
example_zh: 他被一个身材两倍于他的男孩按在篱笆上, 喘不过气来.

example_en: The rain was not sufficient to do any harm.
example_zh: 雨量不足对庄稼有害.

example_en: This flood will be the ruin of the harvest.
example_zh: 这场洪水将是没有收成的祸根.

meaning_zh: pron.（反身代词）她自己,（用以加强语气）她亲自，她本人
example_en: She picked herself up, brushed herself down, and started walking again.
example_zh: 她爬起来, 掸掸身上的灰尘, 又往前走去.

meaning_zh: pron.（反身代词）他自己,（用以加强语气）他亲自，他本人
example_en: He professed himself fond of music.
example_zh: 他承认自己喜欢音乐.

meaning_zh: num.一百,许多,100 到 999 间的数目,某个世纪的年代
example_en: The reading room can hold a hundred people.
example_zh: 这个阅览室能容100人.

meaning_zh: n.疾病,某种具体疾病,不健康
example_en: He succeeded in pulling through the illness.
example_zh: 这场病他硬挺过来了.
